title: Prove disabled workspace tools never invoke workspace modules
goal: Strengthen M8 integration coverage so globally disabled workspace tools cannot invoke read, search, or write modules or emit successful workspace Skill observations.
context: Issue #347 requires capability boundaries to fail closed. Existing coverage checks that chat Skill/team calls return nil and that no blocked file is created, but it does not assert that every relevant workspace module was not invoked under the global workspaceToolsEnabled=false setting.
forbidden_changes: Do not change production runtime behavior or grant capabilities.
Do not weaken Settings policy, Agent scope, approval, schema validation, cancellation, workspace path/protected-file checks, secret scanning, size limits, or verification.
Do not treat absence of a file alone as proof that no capability execution occurred.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance from CI.
acceptance_criteria: With workspaceToolsEnabled=false, chat create/search/read and team search/read remain unavailable.
No moduleInvoked event occurs for tool.workspace.write, tool.workspace.search, or tool.workspace.read.
No successful Skill observation is emitted for workspace.create-file, workspace.search, or workspace.read-file.
No denied target file is created.
Existing enabled-workspace positive-path tests remain unchanged.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If contract validation or any required CI gate fails, repair only within the declared allowed_paths; otherwise revert this single logical task and retain failure evidence. Do not bypass policy checks or claim physical-device acceptance.
